milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce_planks structure is at ~3,0,3 to ~5,3,5 (center ~4,2,4). Using max_distance=5 to require the player to actually walk TO the structure (it's ~5 blocks from spawn), not just see it from afar. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_fence_gate results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player has 2 oak_planks and 4 sticks (the correct recipe for 1 oak_fence_gate) and a crafting table is at ~3,0,6 adjacent to the spruce_planks. The crafted item is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms crafting success.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown_concrete structure is at ~-2,0,9 to ~0,3,11 (center ~-1,2,10). Using max_distance=5 to require the player to walk forward ~10 blocks from spawn to get close to the structure. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it when nearby.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The black_wool structure is at ~-5,0,15 to ~-3,3,17 (center ~-4,2,16). Using max_distance=5 to require the player to navigate past the brown_concrete and walk to the black_wool structure (~17 blocks from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.
